corrected_test_failures.analysis: Boundary 5 (durable adoption intent before fencing) retained an uncompleted primary reservation. The owner detects the killed controller after SIGSTOP, conservatively completes the unknown reply, and retains a full lease from that detection. The observed expiry was 5018 ms after the stop, while the assertion incorrectly required at most 5000 ms from the earlier stop. Authority was fenced and reservations were zero. Correct the bound to the observed recovery interval only for boundary 5 and additionally require the unchanged fixed recall deadline at every adoption crash boundary.

The new negative-generation test selected its expected error using mixed signed/unsigned JSON equality. An isolated C++ reproduction with the pinned nlohmann JSON 3.12.0 confirms json(-1) == json(UINT64_MAX) and therefore incorrectly expects operation_limit for -1. Production validation rejects signed negative values before conversion. Replace test expectation inference with an explicit value/error table and retain actual/expected error diagnostics.
